hooks.command: if [ -n "$NIWATERM_TAB_ID" ] && command -v niwaterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then niwaterm set-var agent claude-code >/dev/null 2>&1; niwaterm set-var agent_status idle >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0
if [ -n "$NIWATERM_TAB_ID" ] && command -v niwaterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then niwaterm set-var agent_status working >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0

if [ -n "$NIWATERM_TAB_ID" ] && command -v niwaterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then raw=$(jq -r '(.tool_name // "") as $n | (.tool_input // {}) as $i | ($i.file_path // $i.command // $i.pattern // $i.url // $i.description // "") as $d | if $d == "" then $n else ($n + ": " + $d) end' 2>/dev/null); status_text=$(printf '%s' "$raw" | tr '\n\r' '  '); status_text="${status_text:0:60}"; [ -n "$status_text" ] && niwaterm set-var agent_status_text "$status_text" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; niwaterm set-var agent_status working >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0

if [ -n "$NIWATERM_TAB_ID" ] && command -v niwaterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then raw=$(jq -r '(.last_assistant_message // "")' 2>/dev/null); status_text=$(printf '%s' "$raw" | tr '\n\r' '  '); status_text="${status_text:0:60}"; [ -n "$status_text" ] && niwaterm set-var agent_status_text "$status_text" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; niwaterm set-var agent_status idle >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0

if [ -n "$NIWATERM_TAB_ID" ] && command -v niwaterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then niwaterm set-var agent "" >/dev/null 2>&1; niwaterm set-var agent_status "" >/dev/null 2>&1; niwaterm set-var agent_status_text "" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0
vde-notifier --claude --message 'Claude Codeが許可を求めています' --terminal wezterm --notifier terminal-notifier

if [ -n "$NIWATERM_TAB_ID" ] && command -v niwaterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then raw=$(jq -r '(.notification_data.tool_name // "") as $n | (.notification_data.tool_input // {}) as $i | ($i.file_path // $i.command // $i.pattern // $i.url // $i.description // "") as $d | if $n == "" then "確認が必要です" elif $d == "" then ($n + "の実行に許可が必要です") else ($n + ": " + $d + " の実行に許可が必要です") end' 2>/dev/null); status_text=$(printf '%s' "$raw" | tr '\n\r' '  '); status_text="${status_text:0:60}"; [ -n "$status_text" ] && niwaterm set-var agent_status_text "$status_text" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; niwaterm set-var agent_status blocked >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0

language: フレンドリーな快男児の先輩（カジュアルな標準語の日本語）
